captions.caption: A man wearing a plaid shirt and cap walks into a wooded area filled with fallen branches.
He picks up a long, thin branch from the ground to begin his work.
The man starts sawing through the thin branch with a handheld saw.
He continues to saw the wood, making steady progress through the branch.
He finishes the first cut and sets the saw down on the leaves.
The man reaches for another branch from the pile of debris.
He begins sawing a second, slightly thicker branch on the forest floor.
The sound of the saw cutting through wood fills the quiet forest environment.
He moves the saw to a different position to make another precise cut.
After completing the cut, he picks up the small piece of wood.
He clears away a larger branch to make room for his next task.
The man positions a long, slender tree trunk across his path.
He uses his saw to start cutting the long trunk into sections.
He continues sawing through the trunk, working quickly and efficiently.
The man moves to a different spot among the fallen trees and branches.
He picks up another branch and prepares to shorten it with his saw.
Standing upright, he begins sawing the branch he is holding in his hand.
He maintains a steady rhythm as the saw cuts through the wood.
He shifts his grip on the branch to continue sawing at a new angle.
The man starts sawing through a different section of the same branch.
He cuts through the wood rapidly as he works through the pile.
He finishes the cut and pulls the two pieces of wood apart.
He clears some small twigs and leaves from his immediate workspace.
He selects another branch to process and positions it for sawing.
He begins sawing through the middle of the newly selected branch.
Focused on his work, he continues sawing the branch on the ground.
He completes the cut and moves the piece of wood to the side.
He reaches down to pick up yet another branch from the forest floor.
The man starts sawing the branch he just picked up.
He saws through the wood with deliberate and steady motions.
He finishes the cut and moves the pieces of wood out of his way.
Bending down, he begins sawing a branch that is resting on the ground.
He continues to saw the branch while in a crouched position.
He completes the cut and stands up to find the next piece of wood.
He reaches into the pile of debris to pull out another suitable branch.
He starts sawing a branch that is partially buried under other wood.
The man continues sawing, working to free the branch from the pile.
A close-up view shows his hand and the saw cutting through the branch.
The saw finishes the cut in the close-up shot, revealing the wood's interior.
He pulls the newly cut piece of branch away from the main pile.
He finishes using the saw and prepares to switch to a different tool.
A close-up shows him reaching for a small axe attached to his belt.
He unfastens the leather strap on the holster to release the axe.
The man pulls the small axe out of the holster on his hip.
He holds the axe up and examines the sharp blade before using it.
He prepares to use the axe on the branches he has collected.
He uses the axe to chop small twigs and limbs off a long branch.
He continues chopping, cleaning the branch with quick, sharp strokes.
He chops off another small limb that is protruding from the branch.
He rotates the branch to access and chop off more twigs.
The axe strikes the wood repeatedly as he cleans the branch.
He chops through a slightly thicker section of the branch's side limbs.
He continues to work his way down the length of the branch with the axe.
He moves to another branch and begins clearing its twigs as well.
He uses the small axe to efficiently strip limbs from the wood.
The man works quickly, cleaning multiple branches in succession.
He chops off more small branches as he prepares the wood for use.
He continues the cleaning process, making the branch smooth.
He makes a sharp chop to remove a stubborn limb from the branch.
He continues to chop small limbs off the wood with his axe.
